name: Invoice with tax
summary: Prices an order from quantity and unit price, applies a quantity discount tier (5, 10 or 15 percent), then adds 8.25 percent sales tax. The discount is cut off at cents, but the tax is rounded to the nearest cent.

paragraphs.name: MAIN-PARA
paragraphs.explanation: Reads quantity and unit price, works out the subtotal, picks a discount tier, takes the discount off, adds tax, and prints subtotal, discount, tax and total.

paragraphs.name: TIER-PARA
paragraphs.explanation: Chooses the discount rate from the quantity: 15 percent for 100 or more, 10 percent for 50 or more, 5 percent for 10 or more, otherwise none. The first matching rule wins.

paragraphs.name: TAX-PARA
paragraphs.explanation: Charges 8.25 percent tax on the discounted amount. Unlike every other step, this one is rounded to the nearest cent instead of cut off, because of the ROUNDED keyword.
